description.value: Booster Juice is a Canadian smoothie and fresh juice chain founded in 1999, offering blended-to-order smoothies, cold-pressed juices, açai bowls, and grab-and-go healthy snacks. This Chilliwack location sits in a strip-mall unit on Trethewey Street and operates as a quick-service takeout counter. For a touring cyclist seeking a fast carbohydrate and vitamin boost between legs, it provides a ready source of fruit-forward drinks and light food.
